reason: A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin for configuring, storing, and hot-syncing local or remote MCP server connections through a web UI.

summaries.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置界面配置、保存并热同步本地或远程 MCP 服务器连接。
summaries.en: Configure, store, and hot-sync local or remote MCP server connections through the DeepSeek Harness web settings interface.

capabilities: Configures MCP servers using stdio or streamable HTTP transports
Stores server connection settings including commands, URLs, headers, environment references, and reconnect policies
Mounts and unmounts MCP client instances when configuration changes
Enables model access to tools exposed by configured MCP servers
